# Wisconsin DNR Apps

> > Wisconsin DNR's comprehensive suite of environmental monitoring, wildlife management, and public health applications for biodiversity conservation, disease surveillance, and natural resource management.

Wisconsin DNR Apps provides interactive tools and data portals for tracking wildlife health, managing natural resources, and accessing public water quality information. The platform serves hunters, farmers, environmental professionals, and the general public with real-time data on deer populations, chronic wasting disease testing, fish consumption advisories, and biodiversity protection.

## Key Topics

- Wisconsin DNR
- Wildlife Management
- Chronic Wasting Disease (CWD)
- Deer Population & Harvest Data
- Biodiversity Conservation
- Rare Animals & Endangered Species
- Natural Communities Inventory
- Fish Consumption Advisories
- Water Quality & Consumer Confidence Reports
- Deer Health Metrics
- Hunter Data & Surveys
- Burn Permits & Fire Safety
- Agriculture Damage Assessment
- Forest Disease Management
- Species of Greatest Conservation Need

## Wildlife & Biodiversity Conservation

- [Protecting Wisconsin's rare animals](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/biodiversity/Home/index/animals): Wisconsin DNR rare animals protection and conservation status
- [Protecting Wisconsin's natural communities](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/biodiversity/Home/Index/Communities): Wisconsin natural communities inventory and biodiversity protection

## Deer Health & Management

- [CWD Deer Testing Results by Deer Management Unit (DMU)](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/cwd/summary/dmu): CWD deer testing results by Wisconsin deer management units
- [CWD Year 2024](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/cwd/Summary/YearZone/2024): Wisconsin 2024 CWD testing results and disease surveillance data
- [Deer Statistics](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/deermetrics/DeerStats.aspx): Wisconsin deer population statistics and harvest data analysis
- [Deer Health](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/deermetrics/DeerHealth.aspx): Wisconsin deer health metrics and winter severity monitoring data
- [Harvest and Population Trends](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/deermetrics/HarvestPopTrends.aspx): Wisconsin deer harvest and population trends analysis
- [Hunter Success and Satisfaction](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/deermetrics/DeerSurvey.aspx): Wisconsin hunter success and satisfaction survey data

## Public Health & Water Quality

- [DNR Fish Consumption Advisory Query](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/fishconsumptionadvisoryquery): Wisconsin fish consumption advisory lookup by county
- [Consumer Confidence Reports](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/ccrpub): Wisconsin DNR public water system consumer confidence reports

## Permits & Fire Management

- [Burn Permits](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/burnpermits): Wisconsin DNR burn permit application and fire safety regulations

## Optional

- [Agriculture Resources](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/deermetrics/AgResources.aspx): Wisconsin deer agriculture damage impact assessment and resources
- [Print Report](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/deermetrics/PrintReport.aspx): Deer metrics report generation and printing tool
- [Heterobasidion Root Disease Interactive Guide](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/forestryapps/rootdisease): Interactive guide for Heterobasidion root disease forest management
- [Consumer Confidence Reports - Tomahawk Waterworks](https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/ccrpub/Home/Index/147590): Water quality consumer confidence report for Tomahawk Waterworks
